lead.title: vLLM 0.29.0 makes Model Runner V2 the default everywhere
lead.summary: The latest vLLM release turns Model Runner V2 into the default for all models and adds CUDA-graph KV-cache memory profiling, batch-sharded sampling, and speculative-decoding upgrades. It also ships new architecture support for Tencent's Hy4, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, and NemotronH, plus large latency optimizations for Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek V4 setups. For anyone serving open-weight models locally, this is the week's most consequential runtime update.

top_stories.title: IBM releases Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2, a SOTA permissively licensed forecasting model
top_stories.summary: IBM's ~385M-parameter time-series foundation model tops GIFT-Eval among replicable zero-shot models under a dual Apache-2.0/OpenMDW-1.0 license, with weights, architecture, and code fully available.

top_stories.title: Japanese retailer warns GPU prices are rising again as the AI memory crunch tightens
top_stories.summary: Applied told customers to buy graphics cards now, following 20-30% hikes and a near-tripling of some GDDR6 spot prices, with NVIDIA and AMD raising the cost of GPU-plus-memory kits charged to board partners.

top_stories.title: Qualcomm's next Snapdragon flagship adds an Element Accelerator NPU aimed at easing the RAM crisis
top_stories.summary: The upcoming Hexagon NPU gains an Element Accelerator and 50% more shared memory, keeping model state, context, and KV-cache close to the accelerator, alongside the world's first 5 GHz mobile CPU and an Adreno Neural Fusion GPU.

top_stories.title: Harvey raises $550M at a $15.5B valuation, a record for legal AI
top_stories.summary: The legal-AI startup's growth round is co-led by new investors Diffusion and Lightspeed, with Sequoia, a16z, and others participating. Harvey serves 80% of the Am Law 100 and reports over $400M in ARR.

items.title: Forward-free depth pruning removes Transformer blocks via weight redundancy
items.summary: Weight-Redundancy Pruning (WRP) drops complete blocks using inter-block weight similarity instead of activation-based forward passes, cutting LLM inference cost without calibration data.

items.title: Joint KV-cache concatenation fine-tuning and recompute for RAG prefill
items.summary: The paper tackles prefill and time-to-first-token blowup in chunk-reuse-heavy RAG by combining KV-cache-concatenation-aware fine-tuning with recomputing caches for reused chunks rather than picking a single strategy.

items.title: AuK: open 1.5B speech foundation model unifying generation and editing
items.summary: Shanghai Jiao Tong (Tencent org) released the MIT-licensed diffusion-transformer model on Hugging Face, unifying zero-shot TTS, editing, enhancement, and source separation behind natural-language instructions. Weights-only at roughly 6.1 GB per variant, with no hosted API.

items.title: UI-Mate-9B open-weight GUI agent runs computer use on a single GPU
items.summary: Tencent HY Frontier's Apache-2.0 agent observes screenshots and emits structured keyboard and mouse actions, scoring 66.2 on OSWorld-Verified, with 27B checkpoints included and vLLM plus OpenAI-compatible serving.

items.title: OxCoder-9B: agentic coding model distilled from frontier traces
items.summary: The Apache-2.0 9B built on Qwen3.5-9B is trained on Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex traces with routing-guided post-training, claiming frontier-adjacent agentic coding results across a 256K context window.

items.title: NeoHorse-1-9B RSI prototype ships GGUF builds for local runtimes
items.summary: The Qwen3.5-9B model is post-trained with routing-guided agentic post-training and released as BF16 plus 4-, 5-, and 8-bit GGUF for llama.cpp, Ollama, and LM Studio, with a native 262K context for consumer hardware.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash IQ1_S-XL: 61.6 GB quant aims a 284B model at consumer GPUs
items.summary: The MIT-licensed GGUF split into two shards comes with a V4-aware llama.cpp fork and llama-cpp-python instructions, letting the 284B MoE run with roughly 35 GPU layers on consumer hardware.

items.title: llama.cpp b10883 reworks Vulkan compute with Ampere regression fix
items.summary: The latest build lands reworked Vulkan compute with spec-constant matrix-multiplication types)Skip a coopmat2 q4_k/q5_k shader split to fix an Ampere regression,Skip and TQ1_0 plus Intel f16 tuning across CPU,Skip Vulkan,Skip and ROCm binaries.

items.title: Hydra: open-source agentic terminal with a PTY daemon
items.summary: The Rust-based terminal discovers agent sessions already running on your machine,Skip keeps them alive after the app closes,Skip and exposes them from a browser with no inbound port.

items.title: BiNeuron: AI code assistant that runs 100% locally
items.summary: The fully offline assistant detects the programming language from requests or files,Skip routes to hardware-matched local models,Skip and extracts text from PDFs,Skip Word docs,Skip and images via OCR before generating code,Skip docs,Skip or analysis.

items.title: computer-use-mcp: Rust MCP server for direct OS control
items.summary: A high-performance cross-platform server and client handling screenshots,Skip mouse,Skip keyboard,Skip clipboard,Skip and app management in-process,Skip giving MCP-capable agents direct control of the local machine.

items.title: Rayrun: one endpoint for every MCP tool
items.summary: An MCP gateway that builds and hosts servers from source behind a single URL,Skip deciding each call per client,Skip tool,Skip and argument,Skip working with Claude Code,Skip Codex,Skip Cursor,Skip and OpenCode clients.

items.title: Experimental patches get open-source Nouveau and NVK drivers running on DGX Spark GB10
items.summary: David Airlie's roughly 100 patches,Skipping including R610 firmware,Skip display,Skip and VRAM/cache fixes,Skip open an open-source Linux driver path for NVIDIA's GB10-based desktop appliances.

items.title: Radeon RX 9070 XT becomes AMD's most popular discrete GPU on Steam
items.summary: Valve's August survey shows the card at 1.46% share,Skip edging past the GeForce RTX 3080,Skipping and making it AMD's most-used discrete GPU,Skipping though the RTX 5070 still leads overall.

items.title: Framework cuts Laptop 13 Pro prices after finding cheaper LPCAMM2 stock
items.summary: A rare reversal amid the 2026 memory shortage,Skip as cheaper LPCAMM2 RAM inventory signals at least partial easing in module pricing for AI-capable laptops.
